releases.body: The TUI context chip now refreshes on session usage and compaction events, with a short poll as a fallback, so it tracks the live context size and drops back after a compaction.
TUI log lines use a single prefix.
README tidy-up. Published to npm as `@hacky.software/opencode-autocompact@0.1.2` by the GitHub OIDC publish workflow.
Published to npm as `@hacky.software/opencode-autocompact@0.1.1` via GitHub OIDC trusted publishing.

First release.

- `/autocompact <n|Nk|Nm>` sets a per-session compaction threshold, inherited by child/subagent sessions.
- Watcher requests compaction via `ctx.session.compact` once the live context (`tokens.input + cache.read + cache.write`) reaches the threshold.
- `/autocompact off` reverts a branch to OpenCode's normal auto-compaction; no threshold means the plugin stays out of the way.
- 32 unit tests; live-verified against OpenCode 2.0.24.
